Here's a quick recap of the events so far:
A troll girl named TRIXIE lands on earth. At college she meets an emo boy named VINCENT who hates her. Despite this, she attains NATIONWIDE POPULARITY in less than a day. Vincent's mom that he hates allows her to stay at their house, becoming her effective HOST FAMILY. Vincent and Trixie will now share a House.

Wow. That was short, wasn't it? I mean it's kind of weird, with most MSPFAs you'd expect this narrative break like, 1000 pages in. But this isn't most MSPFAs.

The subsequent chapters will likely be longer, the sole purpose of this one was exposition.
I decided to include this authorsona segment because I like you. And I like making comics. And I want to talk to you, the reader, as you read the comic! Like a little book club, right? I think that's cute enough.

Of course, I won't tell you what to think about this comic. You probably think it's mediocre already. I mean, look at how INCONSISTENT the characters are!

That's because I wrote this on and off over the course of several months lol!

No seriously, there are a lot of factors that contribute to slow update speeds including but not limited to: College, attention span issues, my alternating phase interest in Homestuck, moving to a completely new operating system 3 times and having to transition stuff from CSP to Krita, and art/writer's block

Because of this, I've developed a work ethic of: Work a little bit on the update. Do absolutely nothing of value for 2-∞ weeks. Decide to work on the entire update until 5AM one day and post it. And then write an entire author's segment for the next 2 hours and post that too. Repeat.


Sighhh... this is getting quite narcissistic! Oh well.
